sources.primary_title: IFS brings industrial AI from experimentation to execution at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026 in Riyadh, IFS and Microsoft are partnering to demonstrate how Industrial AI can move from experimentation to real-world execution. The focus is on asset-intensive industries where complex operations, critical assets, field work, and service delivery are central to business performance. The partnership aims to accelerate digital transformation on a secure and scalable technology foundation, combining IFS's industry expertise with Microsoft Azure, data, and AI capabilities. Key areas of focus include IFS Loops, Industrial Agentic AI, Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM), Nexus Black (an Industrial AI co-innovation program), and IFS Zero (an agentic emissions operating system). This announcement is distinct as it specifically targets industrial and asset-heavy sectors in the context of Saudi Arabia's digital transformation, moving beyond generic AI applications.
sources.verified_key_facts: IFS and Microsoft partnered to showcase Industrial AI at LEAP 2026; Focus is on moving AI from experimentation to measurable real-world outcomes; Key solutions highlighted include IFS.ai, IFS Cloud, Nexus Black, and IFS Zero; Target audience includes asset-intensive industries in Saudi Arabia; IFS is exhibiting within the Microsoft Arabia Hub; IFS representatives, including Suliman Gaouda and Hasan Sakr, will speak at the Microsoft Theatre during the event.
